evidence.claim: The proposal panel confirms requirements, generates documents, distinguishes idle/generating/ready/error and exposes immutable download links.
The frontend project boundary validates project id and confirms the complete current requirements revision.
The frontend project boundary validates project id and requests immutable requirements and proposal documents.
The GraphQL mutation generates a project proposal for a project id.
The frontend document route validates ids and streams the private backend response with content headers.
The backend project document boundary streams a project-owned immutable document with recorded MIME type and filename.
The commercial engine evaluates completeness, comparable pricing, component lines, ranges and manual-review reasons.
Proposal generation requires confirmed complete priced scope, persists versioned draft and three immutable documents, and enforces project ownership on download.
The no-index preview uses checked-in sample data, states it is not an editor or live-data route, and renders print guidance plus the proposal document.
The estimateQuote GraphQL query exposes deterministic project discovery and price matching with scope validation.
